title: CBRS Fitz Indoor - LTE Radio
desc: Notre Dame Campus Indoor measurements - Celona CBRS Fitz Indoor CBSDs - QualiPoc LTE Radio CSV
full_data_desc:
Walking measurements conducted from 20250922 to 20260324. This data upload contains QualiPoc CSVs for 4G LTE Radio (connected) measurements.

Notes:
- There are multiple 'Collection' in the CSV for which the measurements were aimed at debugging issues within the network operation, rather than benchmarking performance.
- Please ensure that the 'Data Technology' column reflects the correct technology for analysis (there are rare instances in which 'Data Technology' reported 'Wi-Fi').
- The 'Operator' column gives an idea of which SIM was used for the measurements.
